# voipms_server (Data Source)

Looks up a VoIP.ms POP (`getServersInfo`) by `pop` id, `hostname`, or display `name`.


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_server" "newyork7" {
  hostname = "newyork7.voip.ms"
}

output "pop_id" {
  value = data.voipms_server.newyork7.pop
}

output "label" {
  value = "${data.voipms_server.newyork7.name} (${data.voipms_server.newyork7.hostname})"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) SIP hostname (e.g. `newyork7.voip.ms`).
- `name` (String) Server display name (e.g. `New York 7`).
- `pop` (String) Point-of-presence id (`server_pop`).

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Server country.
- `id` (String) Same as `pop`.
- `ip` (String) Server IP address.
- `recommended` (Boolean) Whether VoIP.ms marks this POP as recommended.
- `shortname` (String) Short server name.
